items.title: Noah Fifita Included in Davey O'Brien QB Class of 2026
items.summary: TUCSON, Ariz. — Arizona Football quarterback Noah Fifita has been selected as one of 30 players included in the Davey O'Brien QB Class of 2026, the Davey O'Brien Foundation announced on Tuesday. With his selection to the QB Class, he is now officially in contention for the 2026 Davey O'Brien National Quarterback Award.
